Subject: Onboarding Week 1: Kickoff, Attendees & Integration Slots

Hi Helen,

Great to connect last week — excited to get Peloton Health onboarded. To make week one productive, can we lock a 60-minute kickoff to align on scope, access, and the integration plan? I’m proposing three windows (all ET):

- Option A: Tue 6 Oct, 10:00–11:00 ET
- Option B: Wed 7 Oct, 14:00–15:00 ET
- Option C: Thu 8 Oct, 09:00–10:00 ET

Please let me know which you prefer and who from your team will attend (engineering, product, security). Quick asks for the kickoff:
- Confirm primary integration contact + Okta/KM team if SSO is required
- Grant a read-only test account for our devs (we can use short-lived credentials)
- Any compliance docs you want covered in the first call

Attached is a short Week1-Onboarding-Proposal (outline + suggested agenda). If you prefer, we can split into two sessions (business & tech).

Thanks,

— Jordan Blake
Enterprise Success Manager
Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai] | +1 (415) 555-0132

Hi Jordan — thanks, this looks good. Samir (Engineering Manager) and I will join. Our preferred time is Option B: Wed 7 Oct, 14:00 ET.

Attendees from Peloton Health:
- Helen Torres — Head of Partnerships (helen.torres@pelotonhealth.com)
- Samir Patel — Engineering Manager (samir.patel@pelotonhealth.com)
- Dr. Priya Rao — Clinical Lead (priya.rao@pelotonhealth.com) — optional for the first 30 mins

Notes / questions:

- Who will own the integration demo?

Confirming Option B. I’ll await the calendar invite + final agenda.

Best,

Jordan / Vivek — quick internal sync before we send the final invite.

Notes:
- I can own the data governance + compliance mini-section (10m) to address PHI concerns; will prepare SOC2 + retention slides.
- Vivek — can you do the integration demo (20m)? If you prefer to split demo into a separate deeper session, we can do a short high-level demo and schedule a follow-up.
- Monica — please join as PM to confirm milestone owners for week one and handoff to CS ops.

Proposed final agenda (60m):
1) Introductions & success criteria (5m) — Jordan
2) Architecture & data flow (10m) — Marissa
3) Integration demo (20m) — Vivek (high-level)
4) Access, keys, and preflight checklist (10m) — Jordan/Monica
5) Next steps & owners (15m) — Monica/Jordan

I’ll attach the Access-and-API-Checklist and a short demo runbook. Jordan, can you send the invite once you have Helen’s confirmation?

— Marissa
